subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `disableBoundaryAwareCache` and default it for DeepSeek, or use the broader config-free transport policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94945?
rationale: Both candidates address the same regression but establish different public provider/config contracts, and repository policy requires explicit ownership of new config/default behavior before merge.

options.title: Adopt the targeted compat contract
options.body: Choose this DeepSeek-only default with an explicit opt-out after the sanitization repair and rebase; it has direct live provider evidence and limits blast radius.

options.title: Adopt the config-free policy
options.body: Choose the sibling only if maintainers want all qualifying OpenAI-compatible routes to share one transport rule and can prove the broader upgrade behavior.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers design a different provider-owned cache capability without adding either current contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the targeted compat contract
recommendation.body: Choose this DeepSeek-only default with an explicit opt-out after the sanitization repair and rebase; it has direct live provider evidence and limits blast radius.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans both the provider-compat/default surface and the cache-boundary implementation, making this the strongest available routing candidate for the product contract choice.
